description: I'm a CS student passionate about AI, space technology, research, and building impactful products. I have experience in ML development, full-stack engineering, and hackathons. I want to bring NASA's forgotten space explorers back to life through an interactive, story-driven experience. Looking for teammates skilled in frontend development, UI/UX, 3D modelling, animation, astronomy, or creative storytelling. Most importantly, I value curiosity, initiative, and collaborative problem-solving!
